title: Review editor performance evidence

environment.host_scope: Local development workspace; CPU model and storage device were not recorded.
environment.services: Synthetic fixture only; no production scans, Mealie, or Gemini services.

catalog_benchmark.source_format: Synthetic staged JPEGs with extraction caches.

browser.source_format: Synthetic staged PDFs with extraction caches.
browser.registration_ledger: Empty before the valid cold browser measurement; 1000 unique registrations afterward.

historical_browser_baseline.cold_registration_window_note: First-to-last registration timestamps; a lower bound on first display, not an end-to-end settled-page timing.

catalog_cold_registration_seconds.note: Synthetic benchmark asserted that the review ledger was absent before cold load and contained all 1000 registrations afterward.

browser_after_catalog_batch_before_edito.gate: Source image wider than 100px, populated recipe title, two editor tabs, visible nonempty active ingredient or step field, and no skeletons.

final_warm_navigation_after_fragment_ms.gate: Same source, title, visible populated active editor field, tab, and skeleton checks as the earlier browser measurement.

caveats: The historical 69.98-second registration window is not directly comparable to browser navigation-to-settled measurements.
Editor interaction before/after values are single browser runs; treat them as directional measurements.
The final three warm navigation samples ran after focused UI tests completed. An earlier 5931 ms sample overlapped those tests and is excluded.
